source.name: North Carolina State Board of Elections — Election Night Results
source.notice: Unofficial election-night results from the NC State Board of Elections, summed from its precinct-level file; the Board does not call races. Refreshed by NCSBE every 5–10 minutes.

FL.name: Florida

source.name: Florida Division of Elections — Election Night Reporting
source.notice: Unofficial election-night results from the Florida Division of Elections' public results files, summed across its 67 counties; the Division does not call races. No results are released before 8 p.m. ET.

FL.note: Florida's files carry no party field; parties are matched by candidate name against the national layer where shown.

source.name: Minnesota Secretary of State — Election Results
source.notice: Unofficial election-night results from the Minnesota Secretary of State's media files; the Office does not call races.

rules: Counts and calls here are civicAPI's; official state cross-checks, where present, are shown beside them with their own source line.
A call is recorded with the time Civic Telemetry first observed it; civicAPI does not publish call timestamps.
Withdrawn calls are retained and marked, never deleted.
